goal: Lets users and external wallets protect specific block ranges from pruning on a pruned node
Solves the gap where a wallet's needed blocks get pruned while it is unloaded
reviewability: Ready: CI passes, no rebase needed, author actively responding as recently as 2026-09-13
agreement: Positive with two full ACKs and a re-ACK after later changes (sedited)
Concept support without deep objection (stickies-v, achow101)
Unaddressed objection: doubts the feature is even necessary, no reply from other reviewers (andrewtoth)
Author gave a detailed rebuttal to that objection but no follow-up yet

categories.name: indexes
why: P2 because it extends the existing prune-lock mechanism to protect block ranges for external consumers
Benefits wallets and index-like software relying on a pruned node, per achow101
Not higher since no concrete data-integrity or performance bug is being fixed and the need is still disputed

categories.name: rpc
why: P2 because it adds two new RPCs giving external software fine-grained control over pruning
Addresses a real pain point endorsed by achow101 and stickies-v for wallets needing rescans
Not higher because there's no compatibility break, no security angle, and demand from a concrete external implementer is unconfirmed
